note: Placeholder metadata and a tiny toy grid. Not a processed HiRISE product. Replace with data/processed/terrain/cost-map.json after 14 Nov 2026.
resample_note: Planning check: averaging 1 m DTM to 5 m reduced the share of >20° pixels from 32% to 26% on one test strip. Indicative only.
slope_limit_note: Illustrative lunar stand-ins (EVA ConOps up to 20°; LPSC 2023 #1413 used a 15° penalty). No Mars-specific limit was found. Say so in the UI.

slope_classes.meaning: impassable in this setting, plus no-data

cost_formula: step_length * (1 + (slope_deg / 10)^2 + k_rough * roughness); cost is blocked if slope > limit or cell is no-data or an obstacle
tilt_validation_note: A 1 m HiRISE DTM under-read rover-reported tilt in the 11 Nov 2026 planning check (about 4–10° under the rover vs 9–17° reported). Add a margin and say so.
